:::{#hero-heading}

Welcome! I am a Ph.D. Candidate in Economics at the [Vancouver School of Economics](https://economics.ubc.ca/), University of British Columbia, and a 2025–2027 Ph.D. Fellow at the [Stone Centre on Wealth and Income Inequality](https://stonecentre.economics.ubc.ca/) at UBC.

I am an applied economist with research interests in labor and health economics.

Before joining UBC, I earned Bachelor's and Master's degrees in Economics from Universidad de los Andes. I also worked as a Research Analyst at the World Bank, in the [Office of the Chief Economist for Latin America and the Caribbean](https://www.worldbank.org/en/brief/2023/02/27/lac-chief-economist), between 2018 and 2021.

:::
